integrity: Exact symbolic determinant check and rational-rank checks reproduced from standalone standard-library code; the proof itself establishes the infinite-size and unbounded-exponent statements. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only positive least-period-six cycles and the nonexistence of shorter positive cycles are classified; higher periods and global orbit behavior remain open.
Both primitive six-cycles were previously displayed by Avila and Khovanova (2014); the proved new content is their exhaustiveness for arbitrary positive integral initial values.
Unlocated later or broader literature may subsume the completeness statement.
title: The two primitive shortest cycles of five-free Fibonacci dynamics
